changes.evidence: Laura's S.H.I.E.L.D. service (Agent 19) is a past group, retired from before Avengers: Age of Ultron; it is revealed in Hawkeye episode 6 by her S.H.I.E.L.D. watch ('They've been out of the game a long time, but their identity is still attached to that watch'). A past group goes first, keyed to her first title (Age of Ultron), and she is Independent from there. Nothing in Hawkeye moves her, so the S.H.I.E.L.D. stage keyed to Hawkeye and the second Independent stage at Hawkeye are wrong.

changes.proposed: remove left title 'Hawkeye' (left becomes ["Avengers: Age of Ultron"])
changes.evidence: In Hawkeye she only helps Clint by phone and gets her old watch back on Christmas (episode 6); she leaves no group there. Her departure from S.H.I.E.L.D. (retirement, then the agency's fall) is already recorded at Age of Ultron.

owner_calls.question: This record joins the main Loki (who dies in Avengers: Infinity War) and the 2012 variant who escapes with the Tesseract in Avengers: Endgame and goes on through Loki S1, Quantumania and Loki S2. Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki keeps them as two characters. Keep one record, or split the variant into its own record (with the TVA, Independent, Kid Loki's Crew and TVA stages moving with him)?
options: Keep one Loki record (the same man up to 2012)
Split: main Loki ends at Infinity War; the 2012 variant gets a record for Endgame (2012), Loki S1, Quantumania and Loki S2
owner_calls.evidence: Endgame: in 2012 a captured Loki takes the Tesseract and vanishes, starting a branch; Loki S1 episode 1: the TVA arrests this variant. The main Loki was killed by Thanos in Infinity War.
